modules.purpose: Silent non-zero exit sentinel for commands that already rendered their own failure output. Uses Runtime.errorExitCode / Runtime.errorReported overrides so the runtime exits with the given code without double-reporting.
Shared effect/unstable/cli flag definitions. Currently only the standard --json flag.
Shared terminal printing helpers. Currently only ordered line printing via Console.log.
Machine-readable JSON output rendering for --json command modes; encodes via S.UnknownFromJsonString and prints to Console, mapping failures to a typed CliJsonError.
Build an object with a property present only when an Option is Some — used to spread optional fields into schema .make() payloads. Dual (data-first/data-last).

Schema-first plan models for repository orchestration runs (yeet-style): phases, step mutability/scope/resume classification, Turbo graph snapshots, run context, plan steps, and step results, plus ordering/quoting/resume-safety helpers.

Subprocess execution for plan steps via effect/unstable/process ChildProcess: captures merged stdout+stderr bounded to 512KiB (with truncation notice), optionally streams live, persists raw output to file, maps spawn failures to @beep/repo-utils DomainError. Non-zero exit codes are values, not errors.
Named repository proof surfaces mapped to `bun run beep quality github-checks <mode>` plan steps.
Barrel re-exporting executor, models, and proofs. Not part of package exports map (./internal/* is null) — internal-only.

Effect-based monorepo analysis/workspace utilities: repo-root discovery, FsUtils service (glob, readJson/writeJson, modifyFile, exists checks), package.json + tsconfig schemas with decode/encode/diff/patch tooling, dependency graph algorithms, workspace discovery, ts-morph service, and shared typed errors. No git or generic exec helpers.

AI-agent metrics domain for the AIMetrics/AgentEffectiveness commands: schema-first models, transcript ingest, encrypted archives, DuckDB derived storage, OTLP export, privacy proofs, retention, scorecards, compose/install rendering, and shell quoting.

Schema-first AI agent config schemas (CodexConfig etc.), source metadata, drift checks, and proven cross-agent transforms. NOTE: NOT currently a dependency of @beep/repo-cli's package.json — reusable only after adding the dep.

Schema toolkit used by all internal modules: tagged error classes with cause/mapError combinators, literal-union kits with derived guards and $match, path normalization. Foundation for any new shared CLI model/error.
Package-scoped identifier/annotation composer used for every schema/service key in repo-cli ($RepoCliId.create("internal/..."), $I.annote / $I.annoteSchema).

Namespace-first effect helper extensions (A, Str, Struct, Record, Predicate, DateTime, Glob, Path, FileSystem, thunk helpers like thunkEffectSucceedNull) plus dual/flow/identity/pipe re-exports. The canonical helper layer commands should prefer over natives.
Terminal color capability: default shared chalk instance, Chalk constructor, and schema-backed color models for styled CLI output.
Color utilities with browser/node variants (Colors.ts / Colors.browser.ts); available to repo-cli for palette/formatting needs.

gaps: Shared git helper module: no internal/cli or repo-utils git wrapper exists; commands re-implement thin git runners with near-identical shapes — Worktree.command.ts:389 runGitCapture, Yeet/internal/Handler.ts:579 runGitOutput + :966 runGitPathList, Yeet/internal/Status.ts:247 runGitPaths, Quality/Tasks.ts:648 runGitLines, Quality/internal/PackageVerify.ts:242 runGitLines, Docgen/internal/Local.ts:387 runGitLines, Docgen/internal/Quality.ts:488 runGitLines.

Changed-files-since-base helper: `git diff --name-only` / `--cached --name-only -z` parsing is re-derived in Yeet (Handler.ts, Status.ts), Quality (Tasks.ts, Quality.command.ts, CoverageRegression.ts), Docgen — no shared 'changed paths vs base/HEAD/staged' function with NUL-splitting and diff-filter handling.

Generic subprocess capture for non-plan commands: internal/repo-run runRepoCommandCapture exists but is plan/DomainError-oriented; ~25 command files call ChildProcess.make directly or define their own capture helpers (Quality/internal/TurboConfigProof.ts:413 runCommandOutput, AIMetrics.command.ts runCapturedCommand/CapturedCommandResult, Research, Fallow, Codex, Graphiti, CreatePackage, Files, Lint, AgentEffectiveness/EvalScorer) — bounded-capture exec with typed errors is reinvented per command.

jsonFlag duplication: despite internal/cli/Flags.jsonFlag, commands redefine Flag.boolean("json") locally (Yeet/Yeet.command.ts:33, Files/Files.command.ts:195, Quality/Quality.command.ts:2739/2813/2821) — the shared flag is under-adopted or lacks per-command description customization.

Shared CLI run-context bootstrap: findRepoRoot is called independently in 20+ command files and each re-derives repoRoot/cwd/branch context; RepoRunContext exists but is yeet/plan-specific — no lightweight shared 'resolve repo root + branch/base once' helper or service for ordinary commands.

Structured terminal rendering: Printer.ts only offers printLines; no shared table/column alignment, section-header, or ok/warn/fail status-line renderer exists (rg for renderTable/formatTable finds nothing), so commands hand-roll formatting.

Shared shell quoting: quoteCommandArg inside RepoRun.models is private (only exposed via commandTextForStep), and @beep/repo-ai-metrics exports a separate shellQuote — two implementations, neither positioned as the shared CLI quoting utility.

Exit-code aggregation: CliReportedExit exists but commands running many sub-checks each invent their own pass/fail summary + failWithReportedExit plumbing; no helper to collect check results and uniformly derive exit code + summary.
@beep/invariant is not a dependency of @beep/repo-cli and is not imported anywhere under its src — invariant-style assertions are unavailable to commands unless the dep is added.
@beep/ai-sync is not in @beep/repo-cli dependencies, so its drift/transform helpers cannot back a CLI command without a package.json change.
